# bioexcel/biobb_pytorch/make_plumed

## Summary

Generate PLUMED input for biased dynamics using an MDAE model.

Generates a PLUMED input file, features.dat, and converts the model to .ptc format.

Nextflow adapter of the [GeneratePlumed](https://biobb-pytorch.readthedocs.io/en/latest/mdae.html#module-biobb_pytorch.mdae.make_plumed) building block of [biobb_pytorch](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_pytorch) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_PYTORCH_MAKE_PLUMED } from 'bioexcel/biobb_pytorch/make_plumed'

workflow {
    BIOBB_PYTORCH_MAKE_PLUMED(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_model_pth_path` | yes | pth | Path to the trained PyTorch model (.pth) to be converted to TorchScript and used in PLUMED |
| `input_stats_pt_path` | no | pt | Path to statistics file (.pt) produced during featurization, used to derive the PLUMED features.dat content |
| `input_reference_pdb_path` | no | pdb | Path to reference PDB used for FIT_TO_TEMPLATE actions when Cartesian features are present |
| `input_ndx_path` | no | ndx | Path to GROMACS index (NDX) file used to define groups when required by PLUMED |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_plumed_dat_path` | yes | dat | Path to the output PLUMED input file |
| `output_features_dat_path` | yes | dat | Path to the output features.dat file describing the CVs to PLUMED |
| `output_model_ptc_path` | yes | ptc | Path to the output TorchScript model file (.ptc) for PLUMED's PYTORCH_MODEL action |
| `versions_biobb_pytorch` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_pytorch', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of GeneratePlumed properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_plumed_dat_path: 'dat']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_pytorch container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_PYTORCH_MAKE_PLUMED' {
        ext.properties = [include_energy: true]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `include_energy` | boolean | true | Whether to include ENERGY in PLUMED. |
| `bias` | array | "[]" | List of biasing actions (e.g. METAD) to be added to the PLUMED file. |
| `prints` | object | {"ARG": "*", "STRIDE": 1, "FILE": "COLVAR"} | PRINT command parameters (e.g. ARG, STRIDE, FILE). |
| `group` | object | {} | GROUP definition options (label, NDX group or atom selection parameters). |
| `wholemolecules` | object | {} | WHOLEMOLECULES options when using Cartesian coordinates. |
| `fit_to_template` | object | {} | FIT_TO_TEMPLATE options (e.g. STRIDE, TYPE, etc.). |
| `pytorch_model` | object | {} | PYTORCH_MODEL options (label, PACE and other parameters). |
